name: codex-bridge
description: Exchange scoped project tasks, messages, and selected files with a paired Codex computer over an existing SSH transport.

interface.shortDescription: Collaborate with a paired Codex computer.
interface.longDescription: Create scoped collaboration sessions, exchange tasks and results, and transfer selected artifacts. Each computer keeps its Codex authentication and execution local.
defaultPrompt: Check my paired computer and collaboration sessions.
Send a task to my collaborator in the selected project.
Inspect replies and results from my collaboration session.
